description: This file defines the RSSCache class used for caching RSS feed data, including methods for setting, getting, and checking cache entries, as well as handling cache files and errors.
external_files: php standard library functions such as mkdir, fopen, fwrite, fread, fclose, file_exists, filemtime, filesize
system directories and files for cache storage

classes.name: RSSCache
classes.description: A class providing caching functionality for RSS feed data, storing and retrieving cached RSS objects based on URLs.

methods.name: RSSCache
methods.description: Constructor initializing cache directory and maximum age for cache entries.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Adds an RSS object to the cache associated with a specific URL.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a cached RSS object for a given URL if available and not stale.

methods.name: check_cache
methods.description: Checks if a URL's cache exists and if the cached object is still valid based on MAX_AGE.

methods.name: cache_age
methods.description: Returns the age of a cached RSS object in seconds.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes an RSS object for storage.

methods.name: unserialize
methods.description: Deserializes cached data back into an RSS object.

methods.name: file_name
methods.description: Generates a filename for cache storage based on the URL.

methods.name: debug
methods.description: Logs debug messages when debugging is enabled.
